Typedef Documentation

typedef struct _HxClipboardEntry_t HxClipboardEntry_t

Clipboard entry object.

This structure is an opaque object concerning installing one or more clipboard elements to the clipboard. The flow is to create a new clipboard entry, use it in various APIs, and after use delete the entry in order to save memory

Function Documentation

HxResult HxClipboardAddElement ( HxClipboardEntry_t *  pEntry,
HxMIMEType_t  type,
void *  data,
uint32_t  size 
)

Add a clipboard element to the clipboard entry.

This function will add an entry to the clipboard element. You can add one or more elements to the clipboard entry via multiple calls of this function. Note that the contents of memory pointed to by the data parameter is not copied until you call the HxClipboardSet() API, so this pointer must remain valid until that time.

Parameters:
pEntry IN: Valid clipboard entry object
type IN: MIME type
data IN: Pointer to the data for the clipboard element
size IN: Size of the clipboard element data
Returns:
HxResult Returns HX_OK if a successful clipboard element is added to the entry.

HxResult HxClipboardClear ( void   ) 

Clears the whole global clipboard.

This function will clear all the entries in the global clipboard The clipboard allocated data is freed.

Returns:
HxResult: Returns HX_OK if successful.

HxResult HxClipboardDeleteEntry ( HxClipboardEntry_t *  entry  ) 

Delete a Clipboard entry.

This function will delete an earlier created clipboard entry object so that the memory is no longer claimed. It will remove the pointers to the clipboard entry elements, but any specific memory allocated by each element is not deleted.

Parameters:
pEntry IN: Valid clipboard entry object
Returns:
HxResult Returns HX_OK if a successful clipboard entry object is deleted.

HxResult: Returns HX_OK if successful.

HxResult HxClipboardMessageGetSize ( const void *  msgData,
int *  pSize 
)

retrieve size of a clipboard entry in a message

When messages arrive that contain clipboard entries, those entries are in an opaque data type. This function returns the size of the data message's data (retrived via the HxMessageGetData call.)

Parameters:
msgData IN: Opaque data returned previously via HxMessageGetData
pSize OUT: length of data
Returns:
HxResult Returns HX_OK, or HX_NULL_POINTER.

HxMIMEType_t *  type 
)

retrieve the mime type of a clipboard entry in a message

When messages arrive that contain clipboard entries, those entries are in an opaque data type. This function returns the mime type from a message's data (retrived via the HxMessageGetData call.)

Parameters:
msgData IN: Opaque data returned previously via HxMessageGetData
type OUT: MIME type of the clipboard data element
Returns:
HxResult Returns HX_OK, or HX_NULL_POINTER.

HxResult HxClipboardNewEntry ( HxClipboardEntry_t **  hEntry  ) 

Create a new Clipboard entry.

This function will create a new clipboard entry object that is used in other APIs for adding elements for final inclusion to the clipboard.

Parameters:
hEntry OUT: Valid clipboard entry object
Returns:
HxResult Returns HX_OK if a successful clipboard entry object is created.

HxResult HxClipboardSet ( HxClipboardEntry_t *  pEntry  ) 

Set the clipboard entry into the global clipboard.

This function will add the specific clipboard entry with its elements to the clipboard, making internal copies of the data in each element. Once you call this function, you can move or delete the pointers you passed in in previous HxClipboardAddElement calls.

Parameters:
pEntry IN: Valid clipboard entry object
Returns:
HxResult Returns HX_OK if a successful clipboard entry object is copied to the global clipboard.
